integrity: The analytic proof and a self-contained numerical/exact-rational checker are embedded; numerical experiments are supporting diagnostics only, not an infinite-time proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-time unconditional variance and L2 law for an equilibrium-initialized scalar OU process with independent Poisson reset to a time-uniformly sampled prior position. No central-limit theorem, almost-sure convergence, or generalized memory kernel is claimed. Broader unindexed stochastic approximation results may imply parts of the conclusion; independent priority and scientific review remain outstanding.
title: An exact occupation-variance transition for memory-reset Ornstein–Uhlenbeck motion
